title: Memory leak and CPU resource regression
root_cause: Unbounded object retention or expensive request work may cause memory and CPU regressions.
resolution: Propose an approved rollback or bounded restart after confirming resource evidence; monitor recurrence.
pattern: heap and CPU growth with restarts, elevated latency or OOM signals
signal: MemoryPressure OutOfMemoryError OOMKilled CPUThrottle heap memory
diagnostic: Inspect memory trend, CPU utilization, restart counts, release timing and suspicious code changes.
text: Synthetic V2 runbook. Sustained heap growth, OOM events and CPU throttling require resource investigation. A restart may temporarily hide a leak; recovery verification must check the trend rather than a single healthy point. Inspect release diffs to separate resource regression from increased legitimate load. Confirm normal database, provider and cache health before dismissing dependency problems.
